An '''adamant dolabra''' is the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] [[dolabra]], made by smithing a [[Diamond Axe|diamond axe]] with [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]]. It mines at speed 13 and has 5000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/adamant_dolabra.json}}</ref>

As a [[dolabra]], it works as both a pickaxe and an axe, at a lower mining speed than the adamant pickaxe or axe.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[Smithing Upgrade Template|smithing upgrade template]] in the template slot, which is not used up. The recipe matches the base by item ID, so an diamond dolabra works as the base as well as a diamond axe; without the template the same base and alloy make an [[Adamant Axe|adamant axe]] instead.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/adamant/dolabra</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines both pickaxe and axe blocks at speed 13.

It mines obsidian, crying obsidian and ender chests at speed 55, far faster than other blocks.

The pack adds beds, candles, cactus and honeycomb blocks to the blocks axes mine quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 7 damage with an attack speed of 1.

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Unbreaking]] II
* {{G|Smelting}} Smelting: makes mined blocks drop their smelted form where the block's loot table supports it: ores drop ingots or [[Silver Bullion|silver bullion]], logs drop charcoal, sand drops glass and cobblestone drops stone.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/sand.json}}</ref>
* [[Efficiency]] I

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Adamant equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}} or [[Adamant Scrap|adamant scrap]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/netherite_ingot_from_blasting_netherite_materials.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
A [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] of level 2 (Apprentice) buys it for one [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/netherite_dolabra.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Added translation support for all armor and tools.}}
{{History line|1.03|The vanilla netherite recipes were blocked.}}
{{History line|1.10|Alloy equipment can be traded to a [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] for its alloy, so players can rebuild old items with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal ingot in the template slot; the slot is left empty. Smithing now keeps the enchantments already on the item. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip, and repair materials were made consistent across all alloys. [[Divinity]] was removed from adamant tools and replaced with Efficiency. The real attack speed and damage now match the tooltip.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older items can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>. Adamant tools now smelt the blocks they mine. Dolabras were redefined as axe (tool) and pickaxe hybrids rather than weapons: damage goes down and weapon intrinsics are removed over time.}}
}}
